citations.defect_finding: Figure 3's InitAttr is guarded 's.t. keys[entity_call] != bottom' -- only if the decryptor ALREADY holds a key. As printed the operation is unreachable for a fresh decryptor, so the functionality can never issue a first key. CORRECTED to '= bottom' (line 9), and the repair is fixed by the source rather than chosen: its own protocol (Fig. 4) guards the matching InitAttr with 's.t. sk_x = bottom' and its setup machine refuses a Register when keys[entity_call] != bottom. Same class as f-asyncmpc's never-firing counter, and flagged the same way on the page.
